title: Refactor Engine MCP Tool Surface and Add Transactions
description: In semio/engine, restrict MCP-exposed tools to start*, finish*, and sum_qu* variants and implement a single session-scoped global transaction mechanism with start_transaction, finalize_transaction, abort_transaction. Transaction must accumulate kit change entries with forward/backward diffs and abort must unwind all backward diffs in reverse order.
summary: Restricted engine MCP tool surface to allowed prefixes (start*, finish*, sum_qu*, finalize*, abort*) and implemented session-scoped single active transaction with rollback stack of kit forward/backward diffs via start_transaction/finalize_transaction/abort_transaction. Added MCP tests for surface and transaction lifecycle/rollback.
